_about: One entry per hotspot icon. `id` is the hotspot id (the join to copy and coordinates). `subject` is the only part of the prompt that differs per icon; the style block lives in gen-icons.py so the set cannot drift. Subjects are drawn from docs/references/wat-ket-exhibition-copy-gpt.md and docs/research/2026-09-23_futures-chapter.context.md.

icons.label: Chiang Mai railway station
icons.subject: a 1920s Thai railway terminus: a long cream station building with a tiered Lanna-style gabled roof, a platform canopy on slender columns, and a small steam locomotive with one carriage standing at the platform

icons.label: Khun Tan tunnel
icons.subject: a forested mountain ridge with a cream stone tunnel portal cut into its base, a single railway track running into the dark arch, dense purple forest on the slopes above

icons.label: Chiang Mai airport
icons.subject: a small regional airport: a low cream terminal with a glass front, a control tower beside it, one small passenger jet parked on the apron with a set of stairs

icons.label: Wat Ket
icons.subject: a riverside Lanna temple: a cream wihan hall with a steep three-tiered roof and gold roof finials, a white bell-shaped chedi behind it, a short flight of steps with naga balustrades, a few purple trees at the wall

icons.label: Ban Tawan — Journeyfolk trust
icons.subject: a traditional teak craft workshop house raised on posts: open-sided, a master's long workbench with exactly three apprentice stools, hand tools hung on a board, a small shrine shelf, a mango tree beside it

icons.label: Wua Lai — the silver quarter
icons.subject: a silversmith's shophouse in a craft street: a two-storey cream shophouse with a wide open ground floor, an oversized repoussé silver bowl displayed in front, a small anvil and hammer, gold detailing on the balcony

icons.label: Lanna World School
icons.subject: a school that grew from a shed: a small timber shed with a corrugated roof beside a newer two-storey cream classroom block with open verandas, a bell on a post, a rack of children's bicycles, a courtyard tree

icons.label: Anusarn — the second site
icons.subject: a school spread through a market street: a row of three cream shophouses with awnings and a covered walkway between them, a rooftop open-air classroom with a shade sail, market stalls at street level

icons.label: KAE, Wiang Kum Kam
icons.subject: the headquarters of a disaster-response corps set among ancient brick chedi ruins: a low modern cream hangar with its door open, a small rescue drone lifting off, a stack of relief crates, a slender radio mast, two ruined purple chedi behind

icons.label: Wat Umong — Waste for Merit
icons.subject: a forest temple on a brick mound with arched tunnel entrances and a bell-shaped chedi on top, surrounded by a community food forest of fruit trees, raised compost beds, and a small open fabrication workshop shed with a solar roof

icons.label: Doi Suthep — L-Pop
icons.subject: a mountain ridge with a golden chedi on its summit and, on a lower shoulder of the ridge, a small open-air festival platform ringed by tall slender resonance posts, with concentric low ripples radiating across the slope

icons.label: Doi Saket — Uncareering Farm
icons.subject: a small commons farm: a cluster of timber farm buildings around a yard, an open tool library shed with tools racked on the wall, one long shared outdoor table, terraced vegetable rows, a rice barn

icons.label: Lamphun hills — drone agriculture
icons.subject: a steep forested hillside with narrow terraces of shade-grown crops under trees, a bamboo-framed cargo drone carrying a crate down the slope, a small solar charging station with panels on the ridge

icons.label: Lamphun — the Ping Plexus
icons.subject: an old walled town: a gilded chedi within a cream temple wall, a stretch of moat and old brick town wall, a small guesthouse with a veranda outside the wall, and a fingerpost with several arms pointing in different directions

icons.label: Mae Taeng — highland tea
icons.subject: a highland tea plantation: curved terraces of clipped tea bushes on a hillside, a cream tea-drying house with a wide roof and a chimney, a few stacked tea chests, a winding mountain road

icons.label: Chiang Dao — beyond the edge
icons.subject: a tall jagged limestone mountain peak with a dark cave mouth at its foot, forest on the lower slopes, a bamboo cargo drone in the air beside the peak, a mountain pass road curving away behind it

icons.label: Scorpion-tailed cargo boat
icons.subject: a traditional northern Thai scorpion-tailed cargo boat (ruea hang maeng pong): a long narrow wooden hull, a tall stern post curling up and over like a scorpion's tail, a low arched cream roof of woven bamboo covering the cargo hold amidships, a long steering oar at the stern and a bamboo punting pole along the gunwale, resting on a short sliver of pale river water, no crew

icons.label: Yunnanese mule caravan
icons.subject: a Yunnanese pack-mule caravan on a mountain trail: five mules in single file, each under a wooden pack saddle carrying two cream bales roped on either side, a small gold bell at each neck, the lead mule with a gold-tasselled headstall, a few purple pines beside the trail, no riders and no people

icons.label: Lan Na bullock cart
icons.subject: a northern Thai bullock cart (kwian): two very large spoked wooden wheels taller than the cart bed, a long bamboo-hooped cream awning arched over the cargo, a single curved wooden yoke pole, and two humped cream oxen standing in harness, a small purple shrub beside it, no driver

icons.label: Ten-wheel truck
icons.subject: a 1960s Thai ten-wheel cargo truck: a rounded cab-over cab in cream with purple trim and round headlamps, a tall wooden slatted cargo body painted with purple and gold geometric panels, a canvas tarpaulin roped over the load, ten wheels, standing on a short strip of purple-grey road, no driver
